snippet.title: What is Pondlife? A Cozy Fish Game!
snippet.description:
Stephen, Bridget and Jonas share with you more about Pondlife ahead of its upcoming launch. Watch until the end for an official launch date! 🦦 💚

💚  To pre-order/pre-register click the link here: https://onelink.to/pondlife 


Pondlife is a love letter to our players who have been requesting a freshwater version of Splash: Ocean Sanctuary over the last 10 years! 

Create your own peaceful pond sanctuary and fill it with colorful, quirky, and curious creatures. 

💚  Collect all your favorite freshwater fish and discover adorable new creatures, from frogs to turtles, to axolotls, and more!  
💚 Take on the role of caretaker for your pond and make it a wonderful home for your creatures.  
💚 A friendly otter will be your guide as you feed and grow fish, unlock new freshwater environments, complete fish events, and restore balance by releasing adult fish into the Great River.  

🦦 To keep up with Pondlife, join us at: 
🦋 https://www.tiktok.com/@runaway.games 
🦋 https://discord.gg/xyCvjRUHtW 
🦋 https://www.instagram.com/runawayplay 
🦋 https://www.facebook.com/runawayplay  
🦋 Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/runawayplaygames.bsky.social
